figure1_cross_model_heatmap: Cross-Model Layer-wise Attention-Update Sensitivity. Identical 3000 questions, 500/task. M=mean_question |logP_Full(t*)-logP_OFF(t*)|, t*=each-model Full first argmax. Each panel independently displays M/max(M), maximum raw nat and own colorbar; not equal absolute scales. Single-layer original P-1 o_proj OFF only; no Decode or generation Accuracy endpoint.
figure2_raw_sensitivity_curves: Real nat sensitivity and Top-1 flips; independent per-model y axes. No smoothing or interpolation. Shading is ordinary descriptive 95% whole-Image-SHA256 cluster bootstrap (20000, seed 20261101), question-weighted. Light band marks the fixed L2-L5 candidate, not an independently confirmed safe window.
figure3_six_task_raw_heatmaps: Six-task signed loss, mean absolute change and flip rate, each model 500/task. All raw numbers, separate colorbars. Signed red is decreased Full-reference first-token probability; negative values retained. These metrics are neither Gold cross entropy nor final-answer Accuracy.
figure4_relative_depth: Relative-depth comparison without interpolation: layer/(L-1), denominators 31/35/27. Upper row raw units; lower row each complete curve divided by its maximum absolute ordinate. Normalized shape is not evidence of equal absolute sensitivity, stage boundaries or shared causal sink mechanism.
